g.text: Floor -2.62 m. Nominal clear height 1.99 m. Room sizes
give the bounding spans in metres.
The ring-station lift lands in a transverse transfer room. Fore and aft vaults open independently for freight handling. The
galley sends meals up the same lift to private dining via the gallery.
